moves: Comparison searches sit at an average position of 26.1 (91,000 impressions): write comparison pages for salons and clinics and link them from the pages that already rank, so tool comparers see the site.

On LinkedIn, Medical Practices brings the most conversions (71, index 147) and Marketing the fewest (1, index 48): keep the clinics campaign aimed at practice managers and drop marketing roles from the targeting.
Setup effort is the top pain (5 of 33 snippets, negative or mixed): add a client import and a 'set up your first staff member' step to onboarding, and lengthen the trial for people mid-setup.
Fitness studios search for class booking (59,100 impressions) but rarely buy (purchase ratio 0.7): until class booking ships, say so on /industries/fitness/ and collect a waitlist.
Templates and checklists draw 123,500 impressions but 0.5% of purchases: add a 'send these reminders automatically' trial path on the template pages and track it.
